key_insight: Learning dynamics in dynamical systems-based generative models can favor low-rank representations, linking feature learning to persistent or training-budget-dependent mode collapse.
engineering_relevance: Generative-model training may miss smaller modes because collapse is stable or those modes require longer to learn.
method: Express gradient flow for a general class of stochastic differential equations as compositions of linear operators.
Relate operator structure to low-rank biases and collapse.
Study stable collapsed solutions and sequential feature learning in variational inference and flow matching.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports two collapse mechanisms in variational inference and flow-matching tasks, but provides no datasets, quantitative metrics, or benchmark comparisons.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish how broadly these mechanisms predict collapse in practical, large-scale generative models.
paper_title: The balance between feature learning and collapse in dynamical systems-based generative models
